primary_point: WHAM fit to the sum of all eight complete ladder histograms, finest registered bin width
primary_log_standard_error: maximum of the leave-one-ladder-out pooled-fit jackknife SE and SE of independent per-ladder log rates
interval: pooled log rate plus/minus t_0.975,7 times primary log SE, exponentiated
within_ladder_variance_for_heterogeneity: maximum of independent time-block log-rate sample variance divided by block count, using4 and8 equal full-ladder blocks
heterogeneity_test: Cochran-style weighted chi-square using within-ladder variances; approximate calibration explicitly labelled
time_stability: paired log-rate difference of second and first temporal halves per whole ladder, assessed across the independent ladders
tail_rule: reject any range losing an observation; no silent clipping
incomplete_cohort: only explicit --available-only monitoring, cannot pass campaign
physical_status: equilibrium gate success does not imply bead/domain convergence or a full rate
